lesson-intro.text: Lie on the grass, look up, and there's a cloud drifting by. Ours is flat underneath and bumpy on top. See the bumps roll along, then float one of your own.

base.text: A cloud sits on a flat bottom. Draw one straight line from left to right.

corner.text: Round off the left end. From the line, curl out and up to a little dip.

small-bump.text: Now the bumps. The first is a small hill, up and over to the next dip.

big-bump.text: The second bump is the biggest. Go high, like a rainbow, and come down.

middle-bump.text: Then a medium bump, a little lower.

last-bump.text: The last bump curls around and lands on the right end of the line.

lesson-outro.text: There it floats, flat below and puffy on top. What shape do you see in your cloud?
